description: A user starts a planned, shortened, or empty workout.
A user saves a completed workout, including duration and whether it came from a programme.
A user discards an in-progress workout.
A user's personalised programme generation or rework succeeds.
A user activates a catalogue programme or resumes a previous programme.
A user saves edits to a programme day's exercises.
A user joins a crew with an invite code.
A user opens the native share sheet for a crew invite.
A user opens the native share sheet for a completed workout card.
